d:
Ravi ne liya hai ek naya roop — he’s more focused, more prepared, and no question paper is a match for him now. But the OSC exam isn’t the only test he’s facing. Life throws its own curveballs, challenging his patience, priorities, and everything he’s worked for.
Will this be the moment Ravi finally cracks the OSC and gets his sarkari naukri?
Or will he remain stuck in the endless loop of being just another aspirant — like so many young Indians chasing government job dreams?
Watch the finale episode — Prateeksha — and witness the powerful conclusion of Ravi’s journey.
